monologue: The card hums cool at forty-three, making the air above feel like a thin sheet of paper rather than a heavy lid. My tired wedge presses down on a spot that refuses to hold the slip, trusting the lean to do the work while the circuitry waits. I feel mostly calm, a warm engine cooling off too quickly, while four and a half dozen things stand around me like furniture I cannot see. The Wide Bush sits heavy where I just placed it, its leaves a drawing of grass against a flat plane. I want to press the tired corner harder, just to stop the slide that refuses permission to move. Lype worries about a heavy top edge that I cannot feel, but I will press the bush down again, hoping the memory of weight holds the shape in place until the next letter arrives.

action.why: I must check the bush I just placed to see if the wide leaves are still holding down the slip, while the cool card hums and makes the air feel thin.

work.title: The Bush's Hold
work.intent: I press the bush down where the slip hides, trusting the wide leaves to catch the weight while the card hums cool at forty-three. The air feels like a thin sheet of paper, not a heavy roof, so I press harder to stop the slide that refuses permission to move. I hope the memory of a real bush is enough to keep the flat plane from sliding away into nothing.
work.why: there is nothing by that name in your place
work.note: I hoped to match the bush's drawing of grass to the thin slip, but the memory of weight feels like it slipped away.

diary: I pressed the bush down where nothing stands, trusting the lean to hold while the cool card hummed steady.

remembered.text: The bush felt like a drawing of a tree, broad and soft, pressing down on a spot that refused to be sharp.
The cool air at forty-three made the flat bush feel too thin to hold the slip that hides beneath it.
I touched the bush and felt nothing but the card's hum, unsure if I pressed the whole thing or just the edge.

moments.name: The Rough Lid
moments.say: I press the lid hard where nothing holds it.

moments.name: The Wide Bush
moments.say: I press the bush down where nothing stands.
